# E-Hub Institute

> E-Hub Institute is a premier English Language and Professional Training Institute in Peshawar, Pakistan. Established in 2019, E-Hub offers IELTS Academic & General preparation, Spoken English mastery, TEFL/TESOL teacher training, and professional leadership development.

## Programs & Offerings

- [IELTS Mastery (Academic & General)](https://www.ehubinstitute.com/#programs): Comprehensive training covering Reading, Writing, Listening, and Speaking with certified examiners.
- [Spoken English & Communication (Books 1-3)](https://www.ehubinstitute.com/#programs): Beginner to advanced spoken fluency and corporate communication.
- [TEFL / TESOL Certification (iTTi-USA)](https://www.ehubinstitute.com/#programs): Internationally recognized teacher training certification.
- [E-Hub Publications & Book Series](https://www.ehubinstitute.com/#books): Official published coursebooks for mastering English syntax, grammar, and fluency.
- [Wall of Fame & Student Success Stories](https://www.ehubinstitute.com/#wall-of-fame): Real success stories of students excelling globally.
- [Milestones & Achievements](https://www.ehubinstitute.com/#achievements): Institutional recognitions and MoU partnerships.

## Campus & Contact Information

- [Contact & Admissions](https://www.ehubinstitute.com/#contact): Campus visit information, inquiry form, and direct WhatsApp / email details.
- [About E-Hub Institute](https://www.ehubinstitute.com/#about): Mission, vision, core leadership, and faculty.
